text.p: RABAT, July 29 Reuter) - These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan meets France's Foreign Minister Hubert Vedrine paying his first visit to Morocco.
- New party made up of dissidents of Socialism and Progress Party (SPP) says it will distance itself from opposition parties grouped in a bloc known as Koutla.
- Explosion of gas cylinder injures 13 including seven seriously in the central city of Fez.
- French minister Hubert Vedrine hopes to reinforce France's presence in Morocco within the framework of privatisation.
- School headmaster charged with abusing 117 children near the southern city of Ouarzazate.
